entries.label: GetIO
entries.d: access the IO structure (mouse/keyboard/gamepad inputs, time, various configuration options/flags)

entries.label: GetStyle
entries.d: access the Style structure (colors, sizes). Always use PushStyleColor(), PushStyleVar() to modify style mid-frame!

entries.label: ShowDemoWindow
entries.d: create Demo window. demonstrate most ImGui features. call this to learn about the library! try to make it always available in your application!

entries.label: ShowMetricsWindow
entries.d: create Metrics/Debugger window. display Dear ImGui internals: windows, draw commands, various internal state, etc.

entries.label: ShowDebugLogWindow
entries.d: create Debug Log window. display a simplified log of important dear imgui events.

entries.label: ShowIDStackToolWindow
entries.d: create Stack Tool window. hover items with mouse to query information about the source of their unique ID.

entries.label: ShowAboutWindow
entries.d: create About window. display Dear ImGui version, credits and build/system information.

entries.label: ShowStyleEditor
entries.d: add style editor block (not a window). you can pass in a reference ImGuiStyle structure to compare to, revert to and save to (else it uses the default style)

entries.label: ShowStyleSelector
entries.d: add style selector block (not a window), essentially a combo listing the default styles.

entries.label: ShowFontSelector
entries.d: add font selector block (not a window), essentially a combo listing the loaded fonts.

entries.label: ShowUserGuide
entries.d: add basic help/info block (not a window): how to manipulate ImGui as an end-user (mouse/keyboard controls).

entries.label: GetVersion
entries.d: get the compiled version string e.g. "1.80 WIP" (essentially the value for IMGUI_VERSION from the compiled version of imgui.cpp)

entries.label: StyleColorsDark
entries.d: new, recommended style (default)

entries.label: StyleColorsLight
entries.d: best used with borders and a custom, thicker font

entries.label: StyleColorsClassic
entries.d: classic imgui style

entries.label: IsWindowFocused
entries.d: is current window focused? or its root/child, depending on flags. see flags for options.

entries.label: IsWindowHovered
entries.d: is current window hovered and hoverable (e.g. not blocked by a popup/modal)? See ImGuiHoveredFlags_ for options. IMPORTANT: If you are trying to check whether your mouse should be dispatched to Dear ImGui or to your underlying app, you should not use this function! Use the 'io.WantCaptureMouse' boolean for that! Refer to FAQ entry "How can I tell whether to dispatch mouse/keyboard to Dear ImGui or my application?" for details.

entries.label: GetWindowDrawList
entries.d: get draw list associated to the current window, to append your own drawing primitives

entries.label: GetWindowPos
entries.d: get current window position in screen space (note: it is unlikely you need to use this. Consider using current layout pos instead, GetCursorScreenPos())

entries.label: GetWindowSize
entries.d: get current window size (note: it is unlikely you need to use this. Consider using GetCursorScreenPos() and e.g. GetContentRegionAvail() instead)

entries.label: GetWindowWidth
entries.d: get current window width (shortcut for GetWindowSize().x)

entries.label: GetWindowHeight
entries.d: get current window height (shortcut for GetWindowSize().y)

entries.label: SetNextWindowPos
entries.d: set next window position. call before Begin(). use pivot=(0.5f,0.5f) to center on given point, etc.

entries.label: SetNextWindowSize
entries.d: set next window size. set axis to 0.0f to force an auto-fit on this axis. call before Begin()

entries.label: SetNextWindowSizeConstraints
entries.d: set next window size limits. use 0.0f or FLT_MAX if you don't want limits. Use -1 for both min and max of same axis to preserve current size (which itself is a constraint). Use callback to apply non-trivial programmatic constraints.

entries.label: SetNextWindowContentSize
entries.d: set next window content size (~ scrollable client area, which enforce the range of scrollbars). Not including window decorations (title bar, menu bar, etc.) nor WindowPadding. set an axis to 0.0f to leave it automatic. call before Begin()

entries.label: SetNextWindowCollapsed
entries.d: set next window collapsed state. call before Begin()

entries.label: SetNextWindowFocus
entries.d: set next window to be focused / top-most. call before Begin()

entries.label: SetNextWindowScroll
entries.d: set next window scrolling value (use < 0.0f to not affect a given axis).

entries.label: SetNextWindowBgAlpha
entries.d: set next window background color alpha. helper to easily override the Alpha component of ImGuiCol_WindowBg/ChildBg/PopupBg. you may also use ImGuiWindowFlags_NoBackground.

entries.label: SetWindowPos
entries.d: (not recommended) set current window position - call within Begin()/End(). prefer using SetNextWindowPos(), as this may incur tearing and side-effects.

entries.label: SetWindowSize
entries.d: (not recommended) set current window size - call within Begin()/End(). set to ImVec2(0, 0) to force an auto-fit. prefer using SetNextWindowSize(), as this may incur tearing and minor side-effects.

entries.label: SetWindowCollapsed
entries.d: (not recommended) set current window collapsed state. prefer using SetNextWindowCollapsed().

entries.label: SetWindowFocus
entries.d: (not recommended) set current window to be focused / top-most. prefer using SetNextWindowFocus().

entries.label: SetWindowFontScale
entries.d: [OBSOLETE] set font scale. Adjust IO.FontGlobalScale if you want to scale all windows. This is an old API! For correct scaling, prefer to reload font + rebuild ImFontAtlas + call style.ScaleAllSizes().

entries.label: SetWindowPos (name, pos, cond)
entries.d: set named window position.

entries.label: SetWindowSize (name, size, cond)
entries.d: set named window size. set axis to 0.0f to force an auto-fit on this axis.

entries.label: SetWindowCollapsed (name, collapsed, cond)
entries.d: set named window collapsed state

entries.label: SetWindowFocus (name)
entries.d: set named window to be focused / top-most. use NULL to remove focus.

entries.label: GetContentRegionAvail
entries.d: == GetContentRegionMax() - GetCursorPos()

entries.label: GetContentRegionMax
entries.d: current content boundaries (typically window boundaries including scrolling, or current column boundaries), in windows coordinates

entries.label: GetWindowContentRegionMin
entries.d: content boundaries min for the full window (roughly (0,0)-Scroll), in window coordinates

entries.label: GetWindowContentRegionMax
entries.d: content boundaries max for the full window (roughly (0,0)+Size-Scroll) where Size can be overridden with SetNextWindowContentSize(), in window coordinates

entries.label: GetScrollX
entries.d: get scrolling amount [0 .. GetScrollMaxX()]

entries.label: GetScrollY
entries.d: get scrolling amount [0 .. GetScrollMaxY()]

entries.label: SetScrollX
entries.d: set scrolling amount [0 .. GetScrollMaxX()]

entries.label: SetScrollY
entries.d: set scrolling amount [0 .. GetScrollMaxY()]

entries.label: GetScrollMaxX
entries.d: get maximum scrolling amount ~~ ContentSize.x - WindowSize.x - DecorationsSize.x

entries.label: GetScrollMaxY
entries.d: get maximum scrolling amount ~~ ContentSize.y - WindowSize.y - DecorationsSize.y

entries.label: SetScrollHereX
entries.d: adjust scrolling amount to make current cursor position visible. center_x_ratio=0.0: left, 0.5: center, 1.0: right. When using to make a "default/current item" visible, consider using SetItemDefaultFocus() instead.

entries.label: SetScrollHereY
entries.d: adjust scrolling amount to make current cursor position visible. center_y_ratio=0.0: top, 0.5: center, 1.0: bottom. When using to make a "default/current item" visible, consider using SetItemDefaultFocus() instead.

entries.label: SetScrollFromPosX
entries.d: adjust scrolling amount to make given position visible. Generally GetCursorStartPos() + offset to compute a valid position.

entries.label: SetScrollFromPosY
entries.d: adjust scrolling amount to make given position visible. Generally GetCursorStartPos() + offset to compute a valid position.

entries.label: PushFont
entries.d: use NULL as a shortcut to push default font

entries.label: PushStyleColor
entries.d: modify a style color. always use this if you modify the style after NewFrame().

entries.label: PushStyleVar
entries.d: modify a style float variable. always use this if you modify the style after NewFrame().

entries.label: PushStyleVar (idx, val)
entries.d: modify a style ImVec2 variable. always use this if you modify the style after NewFrame().

entries.label: PushTabStop
entries.d: == tab stop enable. Allow focusing using TAB/Shift-TAB, enabled by default but you can disable it for certain widgets

entries.label: PushButtonRepeat
entries.d: in 'repeat' mode, Button*() functions return repeated true in a typematic manner (using io.KeyRepeatDelay/io.KeyRepeatRate setting). Note that you can call IsItemActive() after any Button() to tell if the button is held in the current frame.

entries.label: PushItemWidth
entries.d: push width of items for common large "item+label" widgets. >0.0f: width in pixels, <0.0f align xx pixels to the right of window (so -FLT_MIN always align width to the right side).

entries.label: SetNextItemWidth
entries.d: set width of the _next_ common large "item+label" widget. >0.0f: width in pixels, <0.0f align xx pixels to the right of window (so -FLT_MIN always align width to the right side)

entries.label: CalcItemWidth
entries.d: width of item given pushed settings and current cursor position. NOT necessarily the width of last item unlike most 'Item' functions.

entries.label: PushTextWrapPos
entries.d: push word-wrapping position for Text*() commands. < 0.0f: no wrapping; 0.0f: wrap to end of window (or column); > 0.0f: wrap at 'wrap_pos_x' position in window local space

entries.label: GetFont
entries.d: get current font

entries.label: GetFontSize
entries.d: get current font size (= height in pixels) of current font with current scale applied

entries.label: GetFontTexUvWhitePixel
entries.d: get UV coordinate for a while pixel, useful to draw custom shapes via the ImDrawList API

entries.label: GetColorU32
entries.d: retrieve given style color with style alpha applied and optional extra alpha multiplier, packed as a 32-bit value suitable for ImDrawList

entries.label: GetColorU32 (col)
entries.d: retrieve given color with style alpha applied, packed as a 32-bit value suitable for ImDrawList

entries.label: GetColorU32 (col, alpha_mul)
entries.d: retrieve given color with style alpha applied, packed as a 32-bit value suitable for ImDrawList

entries.label: GetStyleColorVec4
entries.d: retrieve style color as stored in ImGuiStyle structure. use to feed back into PushStyleColor(), otherwise use GetColorU32() to get style color with style alpha baked in.

entries.label: GetCursorScreenPos
entries.d: cursor position in absolute coordinates (prefer using this, also more useful to work with ImDrawList API).

entries.label: SetCursorScreenPos
entries.d: cursor position in absolute coordinates

entries.label: GetCursorPos
entries.d: [window-local] cursor position in window coordinates (relative to window position)

entries.label: GetCursorPosX
entries.d: [window-local] "

entries.label: GetCursorPosY
entries.d: [window-local] "

entries.label: SetCursorPos
entries.d: [window-local] "

entries.label: SetCursorPosX
entries.d: [window-local] "

entries.label: SetCursorPosY
entries.d: [window-local] "

entries.label: GetCursorStartPos
entries.d: [window-local] initial cursor position, in window coordinates

entries.label: Separator
entries.d: separator, generally horizontal. inside a menu bar or in horizontal layout mode, this becomes a vertical separator.

entries.label: SameLine
entries.d: call between widgets or groups to layout them horizontally. X position given in window coordinates.

entries.label: NewLine
entries.d: undo a SameLine() or force a new line when in a horizontal-layout context.

entries.label: Spacing
entries.d: add vertical spacing.

entries.label: Dummy
entries.d: add a dummy item of given size. unlike InvisibleButton(), Dummy() won't take the mouse click or be navigable into.

entries.label: Indent
entries.d: move content position toward the right, by indent_w, or style.IndentSpacing if indent_w <= 0

entries.label: Unindent
entries.d: move content position back to the left, by indent_w, or style.IndentSpacing if indent_w <= 0

entries.label: BeginGroup
entries.d: lock horizontal starting position

entries.label: EndGroup
entries.d: unlock horizontal starting position + capture the whole group bounding box into one "item" (so you can use IsItemHovered() or layout primitives such as SameLine() on whole group, etc.)

entries.label: AlignTextToFramePadding
entries.d: vertically align upcoming text baseline to FramePadding.y so that it will align properly to regularly framed items (call if you have text on a line before a framed item)

entries.label: GetTextLineHeight
entries.d: ~ FontSize

entries.label: GetTextLineHeightWithSpacing
entries.d: ~ FontSize + style.ItemSpacing.y (distance in pixels between 2 consecutive lines of text)

entries.label: GetFrameHeight
entries.d: ~ FontSize + style.FramePadding.y * 2

entries.label: GetFrameHeightWithSpacing
entries.d: ~ FontSize + style.FramePadding.y * 2 + style.ItemSpacing.y (distance in pixels between 2 consecutive lines of framed widgets)

entries.label: PushID
entries.d: push string into the ID stack (will hash string).

entries.label: PushID (str_id_begin, str_id_end)
entries.d: push string into the ID stack (will hash string).

entries.label: PushID (ptr_id)
entries.d: push pointer into the ID stack (will hash pointer).

entries.label: PushID (int_id)
entries.d: push integer into the ID stack (will hash integer).

entries.label: PopID
entries.d: pop from the ID stack.

entries.label: GetID
entries.d: calculate unique ID (hash of whole ID stack + given parameter). e.g. if you want to query into ImGuiStorage yourself

entries.label: TextUnformatted
entries.d: raw text without formatting. Roughly equivalent to Text("%s", text) but: A) doesn't require null terminated string if 'text_end' is specified, B) it's faster, no memory copy is done, no buffer size limits, recommended for long chunks of text.

entries.label: Text
entries.d: formatted text

entries.label: TextColored
entries.d: shortcut for PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, col); Text(fmt, ...); PopStyleColor();

entries.label: TextDisabled
entries.d: shortcut for PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, style.Colors[ImGuiCol_TextDisabled]); Text(fmt, ...); PopStyleColor();

entries.label: TextWrapped
entries.d: shortcut for PushTextWrapPos(0.0f); Text(fmt, ...); PopTextWrapPos();. Note that this won't work on an auto-resizing window if there's no other widgets to extend the window width, yoy may need to set a size using SetNextWindowSize().

entries.label: LabelText
entries.d: display text+label aligned the same way as value+label widgets

entries.label: BulletText
entries.d: shortcut for Bullet()+Text()

entries.label: SeparatorText
entries.d: currently: formatted text with an horizontal line

entries.label: Button
entries.d: button

entries.label: SmallButton
entries.d: button with (FramePadding.y == 0) to easily embed within text

entries.label: InvisibleButton
entries.d: flexible button behavior without the visuals, frequently useful to build custom behaviors using the public api (along with IsItemActive, IsItemHovered, etc.)

entries.label: ArrowButton
entries.d: square button with an arrow shape

entries.label: RadioButton
entries.d: use with e.g. if (RadioButton("one", my_value==1)) { my_value = 1; }

entries.label: RadioButton (label, v, v_button)
entries.d: shortcut to handle the above pattern when value is an integer

entries.label: Bullet
entries.d: draw a small circle + keep the cursor on the same line. advance cursor x position by GetTreeNodeToLabelSpacing(), same distance that TreeNode() uses

entries.label: EndCombo
entries.d: only call EndCombo() if BeginCombo() returns true!

entries.label: Combo (label, current_item, items_separated_by_zeros…)
entries.d: Separate items with \0 within a string, end item-list with \0\0. e.g. "One\0Two\0Three\0"

entries.label: DragFloat
entries.d: If v_min >= v_max we have no bound

entries.label: DragInt
entries.d: If v_min >= v_max we have no bound

entries.label: SliderFloat
entries.d: adjust format to decorate the value with a prefix or a suffix for in-slider labels or unit display.

entries.label: ColorButton
entries.d: display a color square/button, hover for details, return true when pressed.

entries.label: SetColorEditOptions
entries.d: initialize current options (generally on application startup) if you want to select a default format, picker type, etc. User will be able to change many settings, unless you pass the _NoOptions flag to your calls.

entries.label: TreeNode (str_id, fmt)
entries.d: helper variation to easily decorelate the id from the displayed string. Read the FAQ about why and how to use ID. to align arbitrary text at the same level as a TreeNode() you can use Bullet().

entries.label: TreePush
entries.d: ~ Indent()+PushID(). Already called by TreeNode() when returning true, but you can call TreePush/TreePop yourself if desired.

entries.label: TreePop
entries.d: ~ Unindent()+PopID()

entries.label: GetTreeNodeToLabelSpacing
entries.d: horizontal distance preceding label when using TreeNode*() or Bullet() == (g.FontSize + style.FramePadding.x*2) for a regular unframed TreeNode

entries.label: CollapsingHeader
entries.d: if returning 'true' the header is open. doesn't indent nor push on ID stack. user doesn't have to call TreePop().

entries.label: CollapsingHeader (label, p_visible, flags)
entries.d: when 'p_visible != NULL': if '*p_visible==true' display an additional small close button on upper right of the header which will set the bool to false when clicked, if '*p_visible==false' don't display the header.

entries.label: SetNextItemOpen
entries.d: set next TreeNode/CollapsingHeader open state.

entries.label: Selectable
entries.d: "bool selected" carry the selection state (read-only). Selectable() is clicked is returns true so you can modify your selection state. size.x==0.0: use remaining width, size.x>0.0: specify width. size.y==0.0: use label height, size.y>0.0: specify height

entries.label: Selectable (label, p_selected, flags…)
entries.d: "bool* p_selected" point to the selection state (read-write), as a convenient helper.

entries.label: BeginListBox
entries.d: open a framed scrolling region

entries.label: EndListBox
entries.d: only call EndListBox() if BeginListBox() returned true!

entries.label: BeginMenuBar
entries.d: append to menu-bar of current window (requires ImGuiWindowFlags_MenuBar flag set on parent window).

entries.label: EndMenuBar
entries.d: only call EndMenuBar() if BeginMenuBar() returns true!

entries.label: BeginMainMenuBar
entries.d: create and append to a full screen menu-bar.

entries.label: EndMainMenuBar
entries.d: only call EndMainMenuBar() if BeginMainMenuBar() returns true!

entries.label: BeginMenu
entries.d: create a sub-menu entry. only call EndMenu() if this returns true!

entries.label: EndMenu
entries.d: only call EndMenu() if BeginMenu() returns true!

entries.label: MenuItem
entries.d: return true when activated.

entries.label: MenuItem (label, shortcut, p_selected…)
entries.d: return true when activated + toggle (*p_selected) if p_selected != NULL

entries.label: BeginTooltip
entries.d: begin/append a tooltip window.

entries.label: EndTooltip
entries.d: only call EndTooltip() if BeginTooltip()/BeginItemTooltip() returns true!

entries.label: SetTooltip
entries.d: set a text-only tooltip. Often used after a ImGui::IsItemHovered() check. Override any previous call to SetTooltip().

entries.label: BeginItemTooltip
entries.c: Tooltips: helpers for showing a tooltip when hovering an item
entries.d: begin/append a tooltip window if preceding item was hovered.

entries.label: SetItemTooltip
entries.c: Tooltips: helpers for showing a tooltip when hovering an item
entries.d: set a text-only tooltip if preceeding item was hovered. override any previous call to SetTooltip().

entries.label: BeginPopup
entries.d: return true if the popup is open, and you can start outputting to it.

entries.label: BeginPopupModal
entries.d: return true if the modal is open, and you can start outputting to it.

entries.label: EndPopup
entries.d: only call EndPopup() if BeginPopupXXX() returns true!

entries.label: OpenPopup
entries.d: call to mark popup as open (don't call every frame!).

entries.label: OpenPopup (id, popup_flags)
entries.d: id overload to facilitate calling from nested stacks

entries.label: OpenPopupOnItemClick
entries.d: helper to open popup when clicked on last item. Default to ImGuiPopupFlags_MouseButtonRight == 1. (note: actually triggers on the mouse _released_ event to be consistent with popup behaviors)

entries.label: CloseCurrentPopup
entries.d: manually close the popup we have begin-ed into.

entries.label: BeginPopupContextItem
entries.d: open+begin popup when clicked on last item. Use str_id==NULL to associate the popup to previous item. If you want to use that on a non-interactive item such as Text() you need to pass in an explicit ID here. read comments in .cpp!

entries.label: BeginPopupContextWindow
entries.d: open+begin popup when clicked on current window.

entries.label: BeginPopupContextVoid
entries.d: open+begin popup when clicked in void (where there are no windows).

entries.label: IsPopupOpen
entries.d: return true if the popup is open.

entries.label: EndTable
entries.d: only call EndTable() if BeginTable() returns true!

entries.label: TableNextRow
entries.d: append into the first cell of a new row.

entries.label: TableNextColumn
entries.d: append into the next column (or first column of next row if currently in last column). Return true when column is visible.

entries.label: TableSetColumnIndex
entries.d: append into the specified column. Return true when column is visible.

entries.label: TableSetupScrollFreeze
entries.d: lock columns/rows so they stay visible when scrolled.

entries.label: TableHeader
entries.d: submit one header cell manually (rarely used)

entries.label: TableHeadersRow
entries.d: submit a row with headers cells based on data provided to TableSetupColumn() + submit context menu

entries.label: TableAngledHeadersRow
entries.d: submit a row with angled headers for every column with the ImGuiTableColumnFlags_AngledHeader flag. MUST BE FIRST ROW.

entries.label: TableGetSortSpecs
entries.d: get latest sort specs for the table (NULL if not sorting).  Lifetime: don't hold on this pointer over multiple frames or past any subsequent call to BeginTable().

entries.label: TableGetColumnCount
entries.d: return number of columns (value passed to BeginTable)

entries.label: TableGetColumnIndex
entries.d: return current column index.

entries.label: TableGetRowIndex
entries.d: return current row index.

entries.label: TableGetColumnName
entries.d: return "" if column didn't have a name declared by TableSetupColumn(). Pass -1 to use current column.

entries.label: TableGetColumnFlags
entries.d: return column flags so you can query their Enabled/Visible/Sorted/Hovered status flags. Pass -1 to use current column.

entries.label: TableSetColumnEnabled
entries.d: change user accessible enabled/disabled state of a column. Set to false to hide the column. User can use the context menu to change this themselves (right-click in headers, or right-click in columns body with ImGuiTableFlags_ContextMenuInBody)

entries.label: TableSetBgColor
entries.d: change the color of a cell, row, or column. See ImGuiTableBgTarget_ flags for details.

entries.label: NextColumn
entries.d: next column, defaults to current row or next row if the current row is finished

entries.label: GetColumnIndex
entries.d: get current column index

entries.label: GetColumnWidth
entries.d: get column width (in pixels). pass -1 to use current column

entries.label: SetColumnWidth
entries.d: set column width (in pixels). pass -1 to use current column

entries.label: GetColumnOffset
entries.d: get position of column line (in pixels, from the left side of the contents region). pass -1 to use current column, otherwise 0..GetColumnsCount() inclusive. column 0 is typically 0.0f

entries.label: SetColumnOffset
entries.d: set position of column line (in pixels, from the left side of the contents region). pass -1 to use current column

entries.label: BeginTabBar
entries.d: create and append into a TabBar

entries.label: EndTabBar
entries.d: only call EndTabBar() if BeginTabBar() returns true!

entries.label: BeginTabItem
entries.d: create a Tab. Returns true if the Tab is selected.

entries.label: EndTabItem
entries.d: only call EndTabItem() if BeginTabItem() returns true!

entries.label: TabItemButton
entries.d: create a Tab behaving like a button. return true when clicked. cannot be selected in the tab bar.

entries.label: SetTabItemClosed
entries.d: notify TabBar or Docking system of a closed tab/window ahead (useful to reduce visual flicker on reorderable tab bars). For tab-bar: call after BeginTabBar() and before Tab submissions. Otherwise call with a window name.

entries.label: LogToTTY
entries.d: start logging to tty (stdout)

entries.label: LogToFile
entries.d: start logging to file

entries.label: LogToClipboard
entries.d: start logging to OS clipboard

entries.label: LogFinish
entries.d: stop logging (close file, etc.)

entries.label: LogButtons
entries.d: helper to display buttons for logging to tty/file/clipboard

entries.label: LogText
entries.d: pass text data straight to log (without being displayed)

entries.label: BeginDragDropSource
entries.d: call after submitting an item which may be dragged. when this return true, you can call SetDragDropPayload() + EndDragDropSource()

entries.label: SetDragDropPayload
entries.d: type is a user defined string of maximum 32 characters. Strings starting with '_' are reserved for dear imgui internal types. Data is copied and held by imgui. Return true when payload has been accepted.

entries.label: EndDragDropSource
entries.d: only call EndDragDropSource() if BeginDragDropSource() returns true!

entries.label: BeginDragDropTarget
entries.d: call after submitting an item that may receive a payload. If this returns true, you can call AcceptDragDropPayload() + EndDragDropTarget()

entries.label: AcceptDragDropPayload
entries.d: accept contents of a given type. If ImGuiDragDropFlags_AcceptBeforeDelivery is set you can peek into the payload before the mouse button is released.

entries.label: EndDragDropTarget
entries.d: only call EndDragDropTarget() if BeginDragDropTarget() returns true!

entries.label: GetDragDropPayload
entries.d: peek directly into the current payload from anywhere. returns NULL when drag and drop is finished or inactive. use ImGuiPayload::IsDataType() to test for the payload type.

entries.label: SetItemDefaultFocus
entries.d: make last item the default focused item of a window.

entries.label: SetKeyboardFocusHere
entries.d: focus keyboard on the next widget. Use positive 'offset' to access sub components of a multiple component widget. Use -1 to access previous widget.

entries.label: SetNextItemAllowOverlap
entries.d: allow next item to be overlapped by a subsequent item. Useful with invisible buttons, selectable, treenode covering an area where subsequent items may need to be added. Note that both Selectable() and TreeNode() have dedicated flags doing this.

entries.label: IsItemHovered
entries.d: is the last item hovered? (and usable, aka not blocked by a popup, etc.). See ImGuiHoveredFlags for more options.

entries.label: IsItemActive
entries.d: is the last item active? (e.g. button being held, text field being edited. This will continuously return true while holding mouse button on an item. Items that don't interact will always return false)

entries.label: IsItemFocused
entries.d: is the last item focused for keyboard/gamepad navigation?

entries.label: IsItemClicked
entries.d: is the last item hovered and mouse clicked on? (**)  == IsMouseClicked(mouse_button) && IsItemHovered()Important. (**) this is NOT equivalent to the behavior of e.g. Button(). Read comments in function definition.

entries.label: IsItemVisible
entries.d: is the last item visible? (items may be out of sight because of clipping/scrolling)

entries.label: IsItemEdited
entries.d: did the last item modify its underlying value this frame? or was pressed? This is generally the same as the "bool" return value of many widgets.

entries.label: IsItemActivated
entries.d: was the last item just made active (item was previously inactive).

entries.label: IsItemDeactivated
entries.d: was the last item just made inactive (item was previously active). Useful for Undo/Redo patterns with widgets that require continuous editing.

entries.label: IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit
entries.d: was the last item just made inactive and made a value change when it was active? (e.g. Slider/Drag moved). Useful for Undo/Redo patterns with widgets that require continuous editing. Note that you may get false positives (some widgets such as Combo()/ListBox()/Selectable() will return true even when clicking an already selected item).

entries.label: IsItemToggledOpen
entries.d: was the last item open state toggled? set by TreeNode().

entries.label: IsAnyItemHovered

entries.label: GetItemID
entries.d: get ID of last item (~~ often same ImGui::GetID(label) beforehand)

entries.label: GetItemRectMin

entries.label: GetItemRectMax
entries.d: get lower-right bounding rectangle of the last item (screen space)

entries.label: GetItemRectSize
entries.d: get size of last item

entries.label: GetBackgroundDrawList
entries.d: this draw list will be the first rendered one. Useful to quickly draw shapes/text behind dear imgui contents.

entries.label: GetForegroundDrawList
entries.d: this draw list will be the last rendered one. Useful to quickly draw shapes/text over dear imgui contents.

entries.label: IsRectVisible
entries.d: test if rectangle (of given size, starting from cursor position) is visible / not clipped.

entries.label: IsRectVisible (rect_min, rect_max)
entries.d: test if rectangle (in screen space) is visible / not clipped. to perform coarse clipping on user's side.

entries.label: GetTime
entries.d: get global imgui time. incremented by io.DeltaTime every frame.

entries.label: GetFrameCount
entries.d: get global imgui frame count. incremented by 1 every frame.

entries.label: GetDrawListSharedData
entries.d: you may use this when creating your own ImDrawList instances.

entries.label: GetStyleColorName
entries.d: get a string corresponding to the enum value (for display, saving, etc.).

entries.label: SetStateStorage
entries.d: replace current window storage with our own (if you want to manipulate it yourself, typically clear subsection of it)

entries.label: IsKeyDown
entries.d: is key being held.

entries.label: IsKeyPressed
entries.d: was key pressed (went from !Down to Down)? if repeat=true, uses io.KeyRepeatDelay / KeyRepeatRate

entries.label: IsKeyReleased
entries.d: was key released (went from Down to !Down)?

entries.label: IsKeyChordPressed
entries.d: was key chord (mods + key) pressed, e.g. you can pass 'ImGuiMod_Ctrl | ImGuiKey_S' as a key-chord. This doesn't do any routing or focus check, please consider using Shortcut() function instead.

entries.label: GetKeyPressedAmount
entries.d: uses provided repeat rate/delay. return a count, most often 0 or 1 but might be >1 if RepeatRate is small enough that DeltaTime > RepeatRate

entries.label: GetKeyName
entries.d: [DEBUG] returns English name of the key. Those names a provided for debugging purpose and are not meant to be saved persistently not compared.

entries.label: SetNextFrameWantCaptureKeyboard
entries.d: Override io.WantCaptureKeyboard flag next frame (said flag is left for your application to handle, typically when true it instructs your app to ignore inputs). e.g. force capture keyboard when your widget is being hovered. This is equivalent to setting "io.WantCaptureKeyboard = want_capture_keyboard"; after the next NewFrame() call.

entries.label: IsMouseDown
entries.d: is mouse button held?

entries.label: IsMouseClicked
entries.d: did mouse button clicked? (went from !Down to Down). Same as GetMouseClickedCount() == 1.

entries.label: IsMouseReleased
entries.d: did mouse button released? (went from Down to !Down)

entries.label: IsMouseDoubleClicked
entries.d: did mouse button double-clicked? Same as GetMouseClickedCount() == 2. (note that a double-click will also report IsMouseClicked() == true)

entries.label: GetMouseClickedCount
entries.d: return the number of successive mouse-clicks at the time where a click happen (otherwise 0).

entries.label: IsMouseHoveringRect
entries.d: is mouse hovering given bounding rect (in screen space). clipped by current clipping settings, but disregarding of other consideration of focus/window ordering/popup-block.

entries.label: IsMousePosValid
entries.d: by convention we use (-FLT_MAX,-FLT_MAX) to denote that there is no mouse available

entries.label: IsAnyMouseDown
entries.d: [WILL OBSOLETE] is any mouse button held? This was designed for backends, but prefer having backend maintain a mask of held mouse buttons, because upcoming input queue system will make this invalid.

entries.label: GetMousePos
entries.d: shortcut to ImGui::GetIO().MousePos provided by user, to be consistent with other calls

entries.label: GetMousePosOnOpeningCurrentPopup
entries.d: retrieve mouse position at the time of opening popup we have BeginPopup() into (helper to avoid user backing that value themselves)

entries.label: IsMouseDragging
entries.d: is mouse dragging? (if lock_threshold < -1.0f, uses io.MouseDraggingThreshold)

entries.label: GetMouseDragDelta
entries.d: return the delta from the initial clicking position while the mouse button is pressed or was just released. This is locked and return 0.0f until the mouse moves past a distance threshold at least once (if lock_threshold < -1.0f, uses io.MouseDraggingThreshold)

entries.label: GetMouseCursor
entries.d: get desired mouse cursor shape. Important: reset in ImGui::NewFrame(), this is updated during the frame. valid before Render(). If you use software rendering by setting io.MouseDrawCursor ImGui will render those for you

entries.label: SetMouseCursor
entries.d: set desired mouse cursor shape

entries.label: SetNextFrameWantCaptureMouse
entries.d: Override io.WantCaptureMouse flag next frame (said flag is left for your application to handle, typical when true it instucts your app to ignore inputs). This is equivalent to setting "io.WantCaptureMouse = want_capture_mouse;" after the next NewFrame() call.

entries.label: PushClipRect
entries.d: Render-level scissoring. This is passed down to your render function but not used for CPU-side coarse clipping. Prefer using higher-level ImGui::PushClipRect() to affect logic (hit-testing and widget culling)

entries.label: AddRect
entries.d: a: upper-left, b: lower-right (== upper-left + size)

entries.label: AddRectFilled
entries.d: a: upper-left, b: lower-right (== upper-left + size)

entries.label: AddBezierCubic

entries.label: AddBezierQuadratic
entries.d: Quadratic Bezier (3 control points)

entries.label: PathArcToFast
entries.d: Use precomputed angles for a 12 steps circle

entries.label: PathEllipticalArcTo
entries.d: Ellipse

entries.label: PathBezierCubicCurveTo
entries.d: Cubic Bezier (4 control points)

entries.label: PathBezierQuadraticCurveTo
entries.d: Quadratic Bezier (3 control points)

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar
entries.d: Disable title-bar

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize
entries.d: Disable user resizing with the lower-right grip

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove
entries.d: Disable user moving the window

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar
entries.d: Disable scrollbars (window can still scroll with mouse or programmatically)

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollWithMouse
entries.d: Disable user vertically scrolling with mouse wheel. On child window, mouse wheel will be forwarded to the parent unless NoScrollbar is also set.

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_NoCollapse
entries.d: Disable user collapsing window by double-clicking on it. Also referred to as Window Menu Button (e.g. within a docking node).

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize
entries.d: Resize every window to its content every frame

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_NoBackground
entries.d: Disable drawing background color (WindowBg, etc.) and outside border. Similar as using SetNextWindowBgAlpha(0.0f).

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings
entries.d: Never load/save settings in .ini file

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMouseInputs
entries.d: Disable catching mouse, hovering test with pass through.

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_MenuBar
entries.d: Has a menu-bar

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_HorizontalScrollbar
entries.d: Allow horizontal scrollbar to appear (off by default). You may use SetNextWindowContentSize(ImVec2(width,0.0f)); prior to calling Begin() to specify width. Read code in imgui_demo in the "Horizontal Scrolling" section.

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_NoFocusOnAppearing
entries.d: Disable taking focus when transitioning from hidden to visible state

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_NoBringToFrontOnFocus
entries.d: Disable bringing window to front when taking focus (e.g. clicking on it or programmatically giving it focus)

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysVerticalScrollbar
entries.d: Always show vertical scrollbar (even if ContentSize.y < Size.y)

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysHorizontalScrollbar
entries.d: Always show horizontal scrollbar (even if ContentSize.x < Size.x)

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavInputs
entries.d: No gamepad/keyboard navigation within the window

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavFocus
entries.d: No focusing toward this window with gamepad/keyboard navigation (e.g. skipped by CTRL+TAB)

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_UnsavedDocument
entries.d: Display a dot next to the title. When used in a tab/docking context, tab is selected when clicking the X + closure is not assumed (will wait for user to stop submitting the tab). Otherwise closure is assumed when pressing the X, so if you keep submitting the tab may reappear at end of tab bar.

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_NavFlattened
entries.d: [BETA] On child window: share focus scope, allow gamepad/keyboard navigation to cross over parent border to this child or between sibling child windows.

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow
entries.d: Don't use! For internal use by BeginChild()

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_Tooltip
entries.d: Don't use! For internal use by BeginTooltip()

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup
entries.d: Don't use! For internal use by BeginPopup()

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_Modal
entries.d: Don't use! For internal use by BeginPopupModal()

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildMenu
entries.d: Don't use! For internal use by BeginMenu()

entries.label: ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysUseWindowPadding
entries.d: Obsoleted in 1.90: Use ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysUseWindowPadding in BeginChild() call.

entries.label: ImGuiChildFlags_Border
entries.d: Show an outer border and enable WindowPadding. (IMPORTANT: this is always == 1 == true for legacy reason)

entries.label: ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysUseWindowPadding
entries.d: Pad with style.WindowPadding even if no border are drawn (no padding by default for non-bordered child windows because it makes more sense)

entries.label: ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeX
entries.d: Allow resize from right border (layout direction). Enable .ini saving (unless ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings passed to window flags)

entries.label: ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeY
entries.d: Allow resize from bottom border (layout direction). "

entries.label: ImGuiChildFlags_AutoResizeX
entries.d: Enable auto-resizing width. Read "IMPORTANT: Size measurement" details above.

entries.label: ImGuiChildFlags_AutoResizeY
entries.d: Enable auto-resizing height. Read "IMPORTANT: Size measurement" details above.

entries.label: ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysAutoResize
entries.d: Combined with AutoResizeX/AutoResizeY. Always measure size even when child is hidden, always return true, always disable clipping optimization! NOT RECOMMENDED.

entries.label: ImGuiChildFlags_FrameStyle
entries.d: Style the child window like a framed item: use FrameBg, FrameRounding, FrameBorderSize, FramePadding instead of ChildBg, ChildRounding, ChildBorderSize, WindowPadding.

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsHexadecimal
entries.d: Allow 0123456789ABCDEFabcdef

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsUppercase
entries.d: Turn a..z into A..Z

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsNoBlank
entries.d: Filter out spaces, tabs

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_AutoSelectAll
entries.d: Select entire text when first taking mouse focus

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_EnterReturnsTrue
entries.d: Return 'true' when Enter is pressed (as opposed to every time the value was modified). Consider looking at the IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit() function.

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_CallbackCompletion
entries.d: Callback on pressing TAB (for completion handling)

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_CallbackHistory
entries.d: Callback on pressing Up/Down arrows (for history handling)

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_CallbackAlways
entries.d: Callback on each iteration. User code may query cursor position, modify text buffer.

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_CallbackCharFilter
entries.d: Callback on character inputs to replace or discard them. Modify 'EventChar' to replace or discard, or return 1 in callback to discard.

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_AllowTabInput
entries.d: Pressing TAB input a '\t' character into the text field

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_CtrlEnterForNewLine
entries.d: In multi-line mode, unfocus with Enter, add new line with Ctrl+Enter (default is opposite: unfocus with Ctrl+Enter, add line with Enter).

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_NoHorizontalScroll
entries.d: Disable following the cursor horizontally

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_AlwaysOverwrite
entries.d: Overwrite mode

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_ReadOnly
entries.d: Read-only mode

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_Password
entries.d: Password mode, display all characters as '*'

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_NoUndoRedo
entries.d: Disable undo/redo. Note that input text owns the text data while active, if you want to provide your own undo/redo stack you need e.g. to call ClearActiveID().

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsScientific
entries.d: Allow 0123456789.+-*/eE (Scientific notation input)

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_CallbackResize
entries.d: Callback on buffer capacity changes request (beyond 'buf_size' parameter value), allowing the string to grow. Notify when the string wants to be resized (for string types which hold a cache of their Size). You will be provided a new BufSize in the callback and NEED to honor it. (see misc/cpp/imgui_stdlib.h for an example of using this)

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_CallbackEdit
entries.d: Callback on any edit (note that InputText() already returns true on edit, the callback is useful mainly to manipulate the underlying buffer while focus is active)

entries.label: ImGuiInputTextFlags_EscapeClearsAll
entries.d: Escape key clears content if not empty, and deactivate otherwise (contrast to default behavior of Escape to revert)

entries.label: ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_Selected
entries.d: Draw as selected

entries.label: ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_Framed
entries.d: Draw frame with background (e.g. for CollapsingHeader)

entries.label: ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_AllowOverlap
entries.d: Hit testing to allow subsequent widgets to overlap this one

entries.label: ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_NoTreePushOnOpen
entries.d: Don't do a TreePush() when open (e.g. for CollapsingHeader) = no extra indent nor pushing on ID stack

entries.label: ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_NoAutoOpenOnLog
entries.d: Don't automatically and temporarily open node when Logging is active (by default logging will automatically open tree nodes)

entries.label: ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen
entries.d: Default node to be open

entries.label: ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_OpenOnDoubleClick
entries.d: Need double-click to open node

entries.label: ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_OpenOnArrow
entries.d: Only open when clicking on the arrow part. If ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_OpenOnDoubleClick is also set, single-click arrow or double-click all box to open.

entries.label: ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_Leaf
entries.d: No collapsing, no arrow (use as a convenience for leaf nodes).

entries.label: ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_Bullet
entries.d: Display a bullet instead of arrow. IMPORTANT: node can still be marked open/close if you don't set the _Leaf flag!

entries.label: ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_FramePadding
entries.d: Use FramePadding (even for an unframed text node) to vertically align text baseline to regular widget height. Equivalent to calling AlignTextToFramePadding().

entries.label: ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_SpanAvailWidth
entries.d: Extend hit box to the right-most edge, even if not framed. This is not the default in order to allow adding other items on the same line without using AllowOverlap mode.

entries.label: ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_SpanFullWidth
entries.d: Extend hit box to the left-most and right-most edges (cover the indent area).

entries.label: ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_SpanTextWidth
entries.d: Narrow hit box + narrow hovering highlight, will only cover the label text.

entries.label: ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_SpanAllColumns
entries.d: Frame will span all columns of its container table (text will still fit in current column)

entries.label: ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_NavLeftJumpsBackHere
entries.d: (WIP) Nav: left direction may move to this TreeNode() from any of its child (items submitted between TreeNode and TreePop)

entries.label: ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_AllowItemOverlap
entries.d: Renamed in 1.89.7

entries.label: ImGuiPopupFlags_MouseButtonLeft
entries.d: For BeginPopupContext*(): open on Left Mouse release. Guaranteed to always be == 0 (same as ImGuiMouseButton_Left)

entries.label: ImGuiPopupFlags_MouseButtonRight
entries.d: For BeginPopupContext*(): open on Right Mouse release. Guaranteed to always be == 1 (same as ImGuiMouseButton_Right)

entries.label: ImGuiPopupFlags_MouseButtonMiddle
entries.d: For BeginPopupContext*(): open on Middle Mouse release. Guaranteed to always be == 2 (same as ImGuiMouseButton_Middle)

entries.label: ImGuiPopupFlags_NoReopen
entries.d: For OpenPopup*(), BeginPopupContext*(): don't reopen same popup if already open (won't reposition, won't reinitialize navigation)

entries.label: ImGuiPopupFlags_NoOpenOverExistingPopup
entries.d: For OpenPopup*(), BeginPopupContext*(): don't open if there's already a popup at the same level of the popup stack

entries.label: ImGuiPopupFlags_NoOpenOverItems
entries.d: For BeginPopupContextWindow(): don't return true when hovering items, only when hovering empty space

entries.label: ImGuiPopupFlags_AnyPopupId
entries.d: For IsPopupOpen(): ignore the ImGuiID parameter and test for any popup.

entries.label: ImGuiPopupFlags_AnyPopupLevel
entries.d: For IsPopupOpen(): search/test at any level of the popup stack (default test in the current level)

entries.label: ImGuiSelectableFlags_DontClosePopups
entries.d: Clicking this doesn't close parent popup window

entries.label: ImGuiSelectableFlags_SpanAllColumns
entries.d: Frame will span all columns of its container table (text will still fit in current column)

entries.label: ImGuiSelectableFlags_AllowDoubleClick
entries.d: Generate press events on double clicks too

entries.label: ImGuiSelectableFlags_Disabled
entries.d: Cannot be selected, display grayed out text

entries.label: ImGuiSelectableFlags_AllowOverlap
entries.d: (WIP) Hit testing to allow subsequent widgets to overlap this one

entries.label: ImGuiSelectableFlags_AllowItemOverlap
entries.d: Renamed in 1.89.7

entries.label: ImGuiComboFlags_PopupAlignLeft
entries.d: Align the popup toward the left by default

entries.label: ImGuiComboFlags_HeightSmall
entries.d: Max ~4 items visible. Tip: If you want your combo popup to be a specific size you can use SetNextWindowSizeConstraints() prior to calling BeginCombo()

entries.label: ImGuiComboFlags_HeightRegular
entries.d: Max ~8 items visible (default)

entries.label: ImGuiComboFlags_HeightLarge
entries.d: Max ~20 items visible

entries.label: ImGuiComboFlags_HeightLargest
entries.d: As many fitting items as possible

entries.label: ImGuiComboFlags_NoArrowButton
entries.d: Display on the preview box without the square arrow button

entries.label: ImGuiComboFlags_NoPreview
entries.d: Display only a square arrow button

entries.label: ImGuiComboFlags_WidthFitPreview
entries.d: Width dynamically calculated from preview contents

entries.label: ImGuiTabBarFlags_Reorderable
entries.d: Allow manually dragging tabs to re-order them + New tabs are appended at the end of list

entries.label: ImGuiTabBarFlags_AutoSelectNewTabs
entries.d: Automatically select new tabs when they appear

entries.label: ImGuiTabBarFlags_TabListPopupButton
entries.d: Disable buttons to open the tab list popup

entries.label: ImGuiTabBarFlags_NoCloseWithMiddleMouseButton
entries.d: Disable behavior of closing tabs (that are submitted with p_open != NULL) with middle mouse button. You may handle this behavior manually on user's side with if (IsItemHovered() && IsMouseClicked(2)) *p_open = false.

entries.label: ImGuiTabBarFlags_NoTabListScrollingButtons
entries.d: Disable scrolling buttons (apply when fitting policy is ImGuiTabBarFlags_FittingPolicyScroll)

entries.label: ImGuiTabBarFlags_NoTooltip
entries.d: Disable tooltips when hovering a tab

entries.label: ImGuiTabBarFlags_FittingPolicyResizeDown
entries.d: Resize tabs when they don't fit

entries.label: ImGuiTabBarFlags_FittingPolicyScroll
entries.d: Add scroll buttons when tabs don't fit

entries.label: ImGuiTabItemFlags_UnsavedDocument
entries.d: Display a dot next to the title + set ImGuiTabItemFlags_NoAssumedClosure.

entries.label: ImGuiTabItemFlags_SetSelected
entries.d: Trigger flag to programmatically make the tab selected when calling BeginTabItem()

entries.label: ImGuiTabItemFlags_NoCloseWithMiddleMouseButton
entries.d: Disable behavior of closing tabs (that are submitted with p_open != NULL) with middle mouse button. You may handle this behavior manually on user's side with if (IsItemHovered() && IsMouseClicked(2)) *p_open = false.

entries.label: ImGuiTabItemFlags_NoPushId
entries.d: Don't call PushID()/PopID() on BeginTabItem()/EndTabItem()

entries.label: ImGuiTabItemFlags_NoTooltip
entries.d: Disable tooltip for the given tab

entries.label: ImGuiTabItemFlags_NoReorder
entries.d: Disable reordering this tab or having another tab cross over this tab

entries.label: ImGuiTabItemFlags_Leading
entries.d: Enforce the tab position to the left of the tab bar (after the tab list popup button)

entries.label: ImGuiTabItemFlags_Trailing
entries.d: Enforce the tab position to the right of the tab bar (before the scrolling buttons)

entries.label: ImGuiTabItemFlags_NoAssumedClosure
entries.d: Tab is selected when trying to close + closure is not immediately assumed (will wait for user to stop submitting the tab). Otherwise closure is assumed when pressing the X, so if you keep submitting the tab may reappear at end of tab bar.

entries.label: ImGuiFocusedFlags_ChildWindows
entries.d: Return true if any children of the window is focused

entries.label: ImGuiFocusedFlags_RootWindow
entries.d: Test from root window (top most parent of the current hierarchy)

entries.label: ImGuiFocusedFlags_AnyWindow
entries.d: Return true if any window is focused. Important: If you are trying to tell how to dispatch your low-level inputs, do NOT use this. Use 'io.WantCaptureMouse' instead! Please read the FAQ!

entries.label: ImGuiFocusedFlags_NoPopupHierarchy
entries.d: Do not consider popup hierarchy (do not treat popup emitter as parent of popup) (when used with _ChildWindows or _RootWindow)

entries.label: ImGuiHoveredFlags_None
entries.d: Return true if directly over the item/window, not obstructed by another window, not obstructed by an active popup or modal blocking inputs under them.

entries.label: ImGuiHoveredFlags_ChildWindows
entries.d: IsWindowHovered() only: Return true if any children of the window is hovered

entries.label: ImGuiHoveredFlags_RootWindow
entries.d: IsWindowHovered() only: Test from root window (top most parent of the current hierarchy)

entries.label: ImGuiHoveredFlags_AnyWindow
entries.d: IsWindowHovered() only: Return true if any window is hovered

entries.label: ImGuiHoveredFlags_NoPopupHierarchy
entries.d: IsWindowHovered() only: Do not consider popup hierarchy (do not treat popup emitter as parent of popup) (when used with _ChildWindows or _RootWindow)

entries.label: ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenBlockedByPopup
entries.d: Return true even if a popup window is normally blocking access to this item/window

entries.label: ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenBlockedByActiveItem
entries.d: Return true even if an active item is blocking access to this item/window. Useful for Drag and Drop patterns.

entries.label: ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenOverlappedByItem
entries.d: IsItemHovered() only: Return true even if the item uses AllowOverlap mode and is overlapped by another hoverable item.

entries.label: ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenOverlappedByWindow
entries.d: IsItemHovered() only: Return true even if the position is obstructed or overlapped by another window.

entries.label: ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenDisabled
entries.d: IsItemHovered() only: Return true even if the item is disabled

entries.label: ImGuiHoveredFlags_NoNavOverride
entries.d: IsItemHovered() only: Disable using gamepad/keyboard navigation state when active, always query mouse

entries.label: ImGuiHoveredFlags_ForTooltip
entries.d: Shortcut for standard flags when using IsItemHovered() + SetTooltip() sequence.

entries.label: ImGuiHoveredFlags_Stationary
entries.d: Require mouse to be stationary for style.HoverStationaryDelay (~0.15 sec) _at least one time_. After this, can move on same item/window. Using the stationary test tends to reduces the need for a long delay.

entries.label: ImGuiHoveredFlags_DelayNone
entries.d: IsItemHovered() only: Return true immediately (default). As this is the default you generally ignore this.

entries.label: ImGuiHoveredFlags_DelayShort
entries.d: IsItemHovered() only: Return true after style.HoverDelayShort elapsed (~0.15 sec) (shared between items) + requires mouse to be stationary for style.HoverStationaryDelay (once per item).

entries.label: ImGuiHoveredFlags_DelayNormal
entries.d: IsItemHovered() only: Return true after style.HoverDelayNormal elapsed (~0.40 sec) (shared between items) + requires mouse to be stationary for style.HoverStationaryDelay (once per item).

entries.label: ImGuiHoveredFlags_NoSharedDelay
entries.d: IsItemHovered() only: Disable shared delay system where moving from one item to the next keeps the previous timer for a short time (standard for tooltips with long delays)

entries.label: ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceNoPreviewTooltip
entries.d: Disable preview tooltip. By default, a successful call to BeginDragDropSource opens a tooltip so you can display a preview or description of the source contents. This flag disables this behavior.

entries.label: ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceNoDisableHover
entries.d: By default, when dragging we clear data so that IsItemHovered() will return false, to avoid subsequent user code submitting tooltips. This flag disables this behavior so you can still call IsItemHovered() on the source item.

entries.label: ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceNoHoldToOpenOthers
entries.d: Disable the behavior that allows to open tree nodes and collapsing header by holding over them while dragging a source item.

entries.label: ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceAllowNullID
entries.d: Allow items such as Text(), Image() that have no unique identifier to be used as drag source, by manufacturing a temporary identifier based on their window-relative position. This is extremely unusual within the dear imgui ecosystem and so we made it explicit.

entries.label: ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceExtern
entries.d: External source (from outside of dear imgui), won't attempt to read current item/window info. Will always return true. Only one Extern source can be active simultaneously.

entries.label: ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceAutoExpirePayload
entries.d: Automatically expire the payload if the source cease to be submitted (otherwise payloads are persisting while being dragged)

entries.label: ImGuiDragDropFlags_AcceptBeforeDelivery
entries.d: AcceptDragDropPayload() will returns true even before the mouse button is released. You can then call IsDelivery() to test if the payload needs to be delivered.

entries.label: ImGuiDragDropFlags_AcceptNoDrawDefaultRect
entries.d: Do not draw the default highlight rectangle when hovering over target.

entries.label: ImGuiDragDropFlags_AcceptNoPreviewTooltip
entries.d: Request hiding the BeginDragDropSource tooltip from the BeginDragDropTarget site.

entries.label: ImGuiDragDropFlags_AcceptPeekOnly
entries.d: For peeking ahead and inspecting the payload before delivery.

entries.label: ImGuiTableFlags_NoBordersInBodyUntilResize
entries.d: [ALPHA] Disable vertical borders in columns Body until hovered for resize (borders will always appear in Headers). -> May move to style

entries.label: ImGuiTableFlags_SizingFixedFit
entries.d: Columns default to _WidthFixed or _WidthAuto (if resizable or not resizable), matching contents width.

entries.label: ImGuiTableFlags_SizingFixedSame
entries.d: Columns default to _WidthFixed or _WidthAuto (if resizable or not resizable), matching the maximum contents width of all columns. Implicitly enable ImGuiTableFlags_NoKeepColumnsVisible.

entries.label: ImGuiTableFlags_SizingStretchProp
entries.d: Columns default to _WidthStretch with default weights proportional to each columns contents widths.

entries.label: ImGuiTableFlags_SizingStretchSame
entries.d: Columns default to _WidthStretch with default weights all equal, unless overridden by TableSetupColumn().

entries.label: ImGuiTableFlags_NoHostExtendX
entries.d: Make outer width auto-fit to columns, overriding outer_size.x value. Only available when ScrollX/ScrollY are disabled and Stretch columns are not used.

entries.label: ImGuiTableFlags_NoHostExtendY
entries.d: Make outer height stop exactly at outer_size.y (prevent auto-extending table past the limit). Only available when ScrollX/ScrollY are disabled. Data below the limit will be clipped and not visible.

entries.label: ImGuiTableFlags_NoKeepColumnsVisible
entries.d: Disable keeping column always minimally visible when ScrollX is off and table gets too small. Not recommended if columns are resizable.

entries.label: ImGuiTableFlags_PreciseWidths
entries.d: Disable distributing remainder width to stretched columns (width allocation on a 100-wide table with 3 columns: Without this flag: 33,33,34. With this flag: 33,33,33). With larger number of columns, resizing will appear to be less smooth.

entries.label: ImGuiTableFlags_NoClip
entries.d: Disable clipping rectangle for every individual columns (reduce draw command count, items will be able to overflow into other columns). Generally incompatible with TableSetupScrollFreeze().

entries.label: ImGuiTableFlags_PadOuterX
entries.d: Default if BordersOuterV is on. Enable outermost padding. Generally desirable if you have headers.

entries.label: ImGuiTableFlags_NoPadOuterX
entries.d: Default if BordersOuterV is off. Disable outermost padding.

entries.label: ImGuiTableFlags_NoPadInnerX
entries.d: Disable inner padding between columns (double inner padding if BordersOuterV is on, single inner padding if BordersOuterV is off).

entries.label: ImGuiTableFlags_ScrollX
entries.d: Enable horizontal scrolling. Require 'outer_size' parameter of BeginTable() to specify the container size. Changes default sizing policy. Because this creates a child window, ScrollY is currently generally recommended when using ScrollX.

entries.label: ImGuiTableFlags_ScrollY
entries.d: Enable vertical scrolling. Require 'outer_size' parameter of BeginTable() to specify the container size.

entries.label: ImGuiTableFlags_SortMulti
entries.d: Hold shift when clicking headers to sort on multiple column. TableGetSortSpecs() may return specs where (SpecsCount > 1).

entries.label: ImGuiTableFlags_SortTristate
entries.d: Allow no sorting, disable default sorting. TableGetSortSpecs() may return specs where (SpecsCount == 0).

entries.label: ImGuiTableFlags_HighlightHoveredColumn
entries.d: Highlight column headers when hovered (may evolve into a fuller highlight)

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_Disabled
entries.d: Overriding/master disable flag: hide column, won't show in context menu (unlike calling TableSetColumnEnabled() which manipulates the user accessible state)

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_DefaultHide
entries.d: Default as a hidden/disabled column.

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_DefaultSort
entries.d: Default as a sorting column.

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch
entries.d: Column will stretch. Preferable with horizontal scrolling disabled (default if table sizing policy is _SizingStretchSame or _SizingStretchProp).

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthFixed
entries.d: Column will not stretch. Preferable with horizontal scrolling enabled (default if table sizing policy is _SizingFixedFit and table is resizable).

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoResize
entries.d: Disable manual resizing.

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoReorder
entries.d: Disable manual reordering this column, this will also prevent other columns from crossing over this column.

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoHide
entries.d: Disable ability to hide/disable this column.

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoClip
entries.d: Disable clipping for this column (all NoClip columns will render in a same draw command).

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoSort
entries.d: Disable ability to sort on this field (even if ImGuiTableFlags_Sortable is set on the table).

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoSortAscending
entries.d: Disable ability to sort in the ascending direction.

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoSortDescending
entries.d: Disable ability to sort in the descending direction.

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoHeaderLabel
entries.d: TableHeadersRow() will not submit horizontal label for this column. Convenient for some small columns. Name will still appear in context menu or in angled headers.

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoHeaderWidth
entries.d: Disable header text width contribution to automatic column width.

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_PreferSortAscending
entries.d: Make the initial sort direction Ascending when first sorting on this column (default).

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_PreferSortDescending
entries.d: Make the initial sort direction Descending when first sorting on this column.

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_IndentEnable
entries.d: Use current Indent value when entering cell (default for column 0).

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_IndentDisable
entries.d: Ignore current Indent value when entering cell (default for columns > 0). Indentation changes _within_ the cell will still be honored.

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_AngledHeader
entries.d: TableHeadersRow() will submit an angled header row for this column. Note this will add an extra row.

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_IsEnabled
entries.d: Status: is enabled == not hidden by user/api (referred to as "Hide" in _DefaultHide and _NoHide) flags.

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_IsVisible
entries.d: Status: is visible == is enabled AND not clipped by scrolling.

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_IsSorted

entries.label: ImGuiTableColumnFlags_IsHovered

entries.label: ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersTopLeft
entries.d: AddRect(), AddRectFilled(), PathRect(): enable rounding top-left corner only (when rounding > 0.0f, we default to all corners). Was 0x01.

entries.label: ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersTopRight
entries.d: AddRect(), AddRectFilled(), PathRect(): enable rounding top-right corner only (when rounding > 0.0f, we default to all corners). Was 0x02.

entries.label: ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersBottomLeft
entries.d: AddRect(), AddRectFilled(), PathRect(): enable rounding bottom-left corner only (when rounding > 0.0f, we default to all corners). Was 0x04.

entries.label: ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersBottomRight
entries.d: AddRect(), AddRectFilled(), PathRect(): enable rounding bottom-right corner only (when rounding > 0.0f, we default to all corners). Wax 0x08.

entries.label: ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersNone
entries.d: AddRect(), AddRectFilled(), PathRect(): disable rounding on all corners (when rounding > 0.0f). This is NOT zero, NOT an implicit flag!

entries.label: ImDrawListFlags_AntiAliasedLines
entries.d: Enable anti-aliased lines/borders (*2 the number of triangles for 1.0f wide line or lines thin enough to be drawn using textures, otherwise *3 the number of triangles)

entries.label: ImDrawListFlags_AntiAliasedLinesUseTex
entries.d: Enable anti-aliased lines/borders using textures when possible. Require backend to render with bilinear filtering (NOT point/nearest filtering).

entries.label: ImDrawListFlags_AntiAliasedFill
entries.d: Enable anti-aliased edge around filled shapes (rounded rectangles, circles).

entries.label: ImDrawListFlags_AllowVtxOffset
entries.d: Can emit 'VtxOffset > 0' to allow large meshes. Set when 'ImGuiBackendFlags_RendererHasVtxOffset' is enabled.
